title: The Glassblower’s Molten Furnace
summary: An interactive Three.js Murano hot-shop at dusk where a white-hot gather is blown, shaped, and quenched into cobalt glass with gold leaf.
description: An interactive Three.js glassblowing workshop set in Murano at dusk. Watch a white-hot gather pulled from the furnace, inflated, shaped with spring jacks, and quenched into a cobalt vessel threaded with gold leaf and projected caustics.
